A constant naming MCP would be decorative: no production input can be compared to it, so the demanded bidirectional served-vs-advertised assertion would be tautological or impossible.

A real FENCE needs a prerequisite/plan amendment that mints a server-authored transport-origin fact at HTTP/MCP ingress and threads it through command dispatch -> daemon-command-registry -> BearerSessionWitness, then the two planned bearer files can enforce an exact frozen survivor roster and its own code/layer.
